proposal: Use inline multiline python -c with raw newlines in cmd.exe bash tool
reason_rejected: cmd.exe line handling silently drops subsequent lines; causes silent no-ops. Fixed by writing probe files to .jcode/session-state/ and gating via tool_preflight P2.

proposal: Use 'where <tool>' in batch scripts to dynamically locate external CLI binaries
reason_rejected: where dynamically self-matches launchers of the same name in current working directory, causing infinite recursive invocation and stack overflow 0xC00000FD. Invocation MUST use absolute paths.

proposal: Re-seed updated memory card directly with memory remember() without forgetting prior card
reason_rejected: Native memory store fuzzy-matches existing near-identical content and reinforces the old card while silently dropping new content. Reseeding MUST execute forget-first.

proposal: Use negation pattern (!logs/**) in repomix customPatterns to override default exclusions
reason_rejected: Repomix default exclusion patterns take precedence over negation patterns in customPatterns; logs/ stays excluded by design and cannot be forced back via negation.

proposal: Demote EPI-extinct-class scars from the static overlay digest to reduce always-loaded context tokens
reason_rejected: Measured 2026-09-06: only 2/93 scars reference extinct classes (both are gate-development meta-lessons; the traps themselves were already converted to tool_preflight.py structural gates per tier doctrine). Demotion removes 40 tokens (2.0%) of a 2015-token render whose cost is set by budget arithmetic (per-scar redistribution + 382-token overhead), not scar count. Any future subtraction proposal MUST first measure the digest budget anatomy and state which lever it moves.
